登录当前系统账户后自动启动，开关立即保存，无需重启。macOS / Window: Start automatically when you sign in. Changes save immediately; no restart needed. Runs in the background on macOS / Windows and opens the main window on Linux.
此开关管理系统启动项，不写入 YAML。若被系统设置禁用，也需在系统中重新允许。: Manages the system startup entry, separately from YAML. If disabled by your operating system, allow it again in system settings too.
请先将打包的 Portway.app 放到固定位置（建议应用程序目录），并从该位: Move the packaged Portway.app to a permanent location (preferably Applications) and open it from there first.
当前平台或应用路径不支持开机自启。: Start at login is unavailable for this platform or application location.
应用路径或启动项已变化，请更新启动项。: The application path or startup entry has changed. Update the startup entry.
自动按目标服务端口识别，不使用监听端口或 SSH 跳板端口。非标准端口可手动选择: Detects the target service port, not the listener or SSH gateway port. Choose manually for non-standard ports. Changing only the icon does not restart the tunnel.
排查连接问题，查看运行事件与访问记录。: Inspect runtime events and connections to troubleshoot your tunnels.
搜索消息、地址或错误，按回车查询: Search messages, addresses or errors; press Enter
当前数据可能已过期，可手动刷新重试。: Data may be outdated. Refresh manually to retry.
当前仅输出到 stderr，未启用日志文件: Logging to stderr only. No log file is enabled.
已达到读取上限：最多扫描最近 2 MiB 日志，展示最新 500 条匹配记录。更: Read limit reached: scans the latest 2 MiB and shows up to 500 matches. Consult the log files for older records.
读取失败，请重试: Could not load data. Please retry.
点击日志行展开原始内容。仅查看日志，不会修改文件。: Click a log row to expand its raw content. Viewing does not modify files.
历史仅包含 SOCKS5 请求，每条线路保留最近 500 条缓存；单次请求失败不: History covers SOCKS5 requests only, with the latest 500 cached per tunnel. A failed request does not mean the tunnel is unhealthy.
当前连接包含所有转发类型，不包含 SSH 控制连接；来源地址固定在左侧。: Active connections cover all forwarding types, excluding SSH control connections. Source addresses stay pinned on the left.
在本机开放端口，经 SSH 服务器访问远端服务。等价于 ssh -L。: Listen locally and access a remote service through the SSH server. Equivalent to ssh -L.
在 SSH 服务器开放端口，把流量转回本机可访问的服务。等价于 ssh -R。: Listen on the SSH server and forward traffic to a service accessible from this machine. Equivalent to ssh -R.
在本机创建 SOCKS5 代理，由客户端为每个连接指定目标。等价于 ssh -D: Create a local SOCKS5 proxy. Each client specifies its destination. Equivalent to ssh -D.
本地转发适合访问内网服务；远程转发适合对外暴露本机服务；动态代理提供通用 SOC: Local forwarding accesses private services; remote forwarding exposes local services; dynamic forwarding provides a SOCKS5 proxy.
线路的唯一标识，用于列表展示和 CLI 操作；创建后不可修改。: Unique tunnel identifier used in the list and CLI. Cannot be changed after creation.
SSH 服务器的 host:port，或 ~/.ssh/config 中的 Ho: SSH server host:port or a Host alias from ~/.ssh/config, such as drop.
SOCKS5 客户端连接的本机地址。建议绑定 127.0.0.1，避免代理暴露给: Local address for SOCKS5 clients. Bind to 127.0.0.1 to avoid exposing the proxy to your network.
本机程序连接的监听地址。使用 127.0.0.1 仅允许本机访问，0.0.0.0: Listening address for local clients. 127.0.0.1 allows only local access; 0.0.0.0 also exposes it to the network.
由 SSH 服务器监听的地址。127.0.0.1 仅服务器本机可访问；0.0.0: Address to listen on at the SSH server. 127.0.0.1 is server-local; 0.0.0.0 also requires GatewayPorts on the server.
SSH 流量回到本机后连接的目标地址，例如本机 Web 服务 127.0.0.1: Destination reached locally after traffic returns through SSH, such as a local web service at 127.0.0.1:3000.
SSH 服务器一侧最终访问的目标服务地址，例如数据库 10.0.0.20:543: Destination reached from the SSH server, such as a database at 10.0.0.20:5432.
登录目标 SSH 服务器的用户名；留空时读取 ssh config 的 User: SSH login user. If blank, use User from ssh config, then the daemon's local username. Jump hosts use their own settings.
daemon 所在机器上的私钥路径，支持 ~/。留空时读取 IdentityFi: Private key path on the daemon host; ~/ is supported. If blank, use IdentityFile or try id_ed25519, id_ecdsa and id_rsa, with ssh-agent support. Unlock encrypted keys in your agent first. The system ssh executable is not used.
SSH 登录密码。建议优先使用密钥；编辑时留空会保留已保存的密码。: SSH login password. Keys are recommended. Leave blank when editing to keep the saved password.
留空保留原密码: Blank to keep the saved password
留空使用 ~/.ssh/config。支持 Host、User、Port、Ide: Defaults to ~/.ssh/config. Supports Host, User, Port, IdentityFile, IdentityAgent and native multi-hop ProxyJump. Common ProxyCommand ssh -W %h:%p drop is handled natively. Custom proxy commands still require their external programs.
保存可信服务器公钥的文件；留空时依次读取 ssh config 的 UserKn: Trusted server public keys. If blank, use UserKnownHostsFile from ssh config, then ~/.ssh/known_hosts.
留空使用默认路径: Blank to use the default path
仅在主机从未被记录时接受并写入密钥；已有记录发生变化时仍会拒绝，防止中间人攻击。: Accept and save a key only for a previously unknown host. Changed keys are still rejected to protect against interception.
首次连接自动信任新主机（TOFU）: Trust new hosts on first use (TOFU)
不验证目标服务器身份，也会接受变化的密钥，仅限临时诊断。此选项不跳过原生跳板的校: Skip destination identity verification, including changed keys. Use only for temporary diagnostics. Native jump hosts still verify their own known_hosts entries.
连接将接受任何主机密钥，包括已发生变化的密钥。请仅在风险可控时使用。: Any host key will be accepted, including changed keys. Use only when you understand and accept the risk.
向 SSH 服务器发送保活请求的间隔，Go duration 格式，例如 30s: Interval between SSH keepalive requests, as a Go duration (e.g. 30s or 1m). Set to 0s to disable.
连接失败或断开后再次尝试的等待时间，Go duration 格式，例如 3s、5: Delay before retrying a failed or disconnected tunnel, as a Go duration (e.g. 3s or 500ms).
已保存到 YAML 文件，退出并重新打开桌面应用后生效: Saved to YAML. Quit and reopen the desktop app to apply.
已保存到 YAML 文件，重启 daemon 后生效: Saved to YAML. Restart the daemon to apply.
文件配置与当前运行配置不同: Saved settings differ from the running configuration
保存后退出并重新打开应用生效: Quit and reopen the app after saving to apply
保存后重启 daemon 生效: Restart the daemon after saving to apply
桌面应用直接托管后端，不开放 HTTP 端口。保存不会中断线路；macOS /: The desktop app hosts its backend without an HTTP port. Saving does not interrupt tunnels. Closing the window on macOS / Windows only hides it; quit from the app or tray menu, then reopen.
保存不会中断线路或自动重启。启动参数优先于 YAML；要使用文件中的值，请移除对: Saving does not interrupt tunnels or restart the daemon. CLI flags override YAML; remove the relevant flags to use file settings. Manual YAML edits also require a restart.
Web 页面与 API 的监听地址，格式 host:port。没有登录认证，建议: Web UI and API address in host:port format. There is no login authentication; binding to 127.0.0.1 is recommended. Use the new address after changing it.
线路定义仍以 JSON 保存。更换路径不会迁移旧线路；请先复制原文件。路径位于: Tunnel definitions are stored as JSON on the daemon host. Changing this path does not migrate tunnels; copy the original file first.
仅影响 daemon 运行日志；SOCKS5 连接历史始终记录，不受日志级别影响: Only affects daemon logs. SOCKS5 connection history is always recorded regardless of log level.
text 适合直接阅读；json 便于日志采集。连接历史始终采用 JSONL。: text is human-readable; json suits log collectors. Connection history always uses JSONL.
同时输出到 stderr 和此文件；留空则仅 stderr。支持 ~/；相对路径: Write to stderr and this file. Leave blank for stderr only. Supports ~/; relative paths are resolved from the YAML file's directory.
SOCKS5 请求结束时追加一行 JSON，包含来源、目标、时间、流量和结果。启: Append one JSON record per completed SOCKS5 request with source, destination, timestamps, traffic and result. On startup, restore the latest 500 records per tunnel from current and rotated logs. Changing this path does not migrate old logs.
对运行日志和连接日志分别生效。达到上限后轮转，不拆分单条记录。: Applies separately to daemon and connection logs. Rotate at the limit without splitting individual records.
不含当前文件；.1 最新。超过数量的最旧文件被覆盖。两个日志各自保留此数量。: Excludes the current file; .1 is the newest backup. The oldest excess files are overwritten. Each log keeps this many backups.
日志保留目标地址等访问元数据，不记录业务内容或 SSH 密码。文件权限为仅当前用: Logs contain access metadata such as destination addresses, not payloads or SSH passwords. Only the current user can read/write the files. Connections active during an unexpected exit may have no complete history.
从接受客户端连接开始计时，包含等待目标连接的时间。: Time since accepting the client, including time spent connecting to the destination.
显示的数据可能已过期，将自动重试。: Data may be outdated. Retrying automatically.
部分连接历史未能写入日志: Some connection history could not be logged
{error}。当前仍显示内存记录，请检查磁盘空间与文件权限；未写入的记录重启后: {error}. In-memory records are still shown. Check disk space and file permissions; unsaved records will be lost on restart.
暂无历史连接，SOCKS5 请求结束后会显示在这里: No history yet. Completed SOCKS5 requests appear here.
展示最近已结束的 SOCKS5 请求（最多 {limit} 条），最新记录在前。: Showing up to {limit} completed SOCKS5 requests, newest first.
连接记录追加到日志文件，停止或重启线路不会清空；重启 daemon 后从保留的日: History is appended to log files and survives tunnel stops and restarts. It is restored from retained logs after a daemon restart. Configure log paths and rotation in Settings.
当前未启用日志持久化，记录仅在本次线路运行期间保留。: Log persistence is disabled; records are kept only for the current tunnel run.
失败仅代表该请求失败，不代表线路异常。: A failed request does not mean the tunnel is unhealthy.
仅展示当前转发连接，断开后移入历史连接，不包含 SSH 控制连接。: Shows active forwarded connections only; closed connections move to history. SSH control connections are excluded.
仅展示当前转发连接，断开后自动移除，不包含 SSH 控制连接。: Shows active forwarded connections only; closed connections are removed. SSH control connections are excluded.
收发以 daemon 所在机器为准，仅统计业务数据。: Traffic is measured from the daemon host's perspective and counts payload bytes only.
daemon 配置与日志设置，保存到 YAML 文件: Daemon and log settings, saved to YAML
还没有线路，创建第一条转发规则。: No tunnels yet. Create your first forwarding rule.
保存的配置也会一并删除，此操作无法撤销。: The saved configuration will also be deleted. This cannot be undone.
本次启动以来，daemon 所在机器通过隧道收到的累计业务数据，不含 SSH 协: Payload received by the daemon host since this tunnel started, excluding SSH overhead. Refreshes every 2 seconds; resets on stop or restart.
本次启动以来，daemon 所在机器通过隧道发出的累计业务数据，不是实时速度。每: Payload sent by the daemon host since this tunnel started, not a transfer rate. Refreshes every 2 seconds; resets on stop or restart.
点击查看每条连接的来源、目标和流量。包含正在连接目标的请求，不包含 SSH 控制: View each connection's source, destination and traffic. Includes pending destination connections, but excludes SSH control connections.
无法访问剪贴板，请手动复制下方命令: Clipboard unavailable. Please copy the command manually.
监听地址无效，请先编辑线路的 SOCKS5 监听地址: Invalid listener address. Edit the tunnel's SOCKS5 listening address first.
线路尚未运行，请启动后再使用代理: Start the tunnel before using the proxy.
设置当前终端的 all_proxy、http_proxy 和 https_pro: Sets all_proxy, http_proxy and https_proxy in this terminal without changing the system proxy. Programs must support socks5h, which resolves DNS through the proxy. App-specific settings and NO_PROXY may take precedence.
请在 daemon 所在机器运行。若从其他机器使用，请替换为可访问的监听地址；不: Run on the daemon host. For another machine, substitute a reachable listening address. Do not expose an unauthenticated SOCKS5 port to the public internet.
